kind: Additional boundary sensitivity recorded before viewing rerun effect estimates; does not amend the frozen primary contract
rationale: Trimming reference onset may left-truncate an existing observed low-pressure run. Confirm that event-information findings do not rely on events with unobserved boundaries.

reference_events: Same >=60s contiguous valid low bins; include only runs preceded AND followed by a finite observed MAP>=65 inside the retained analysis window. Missing or cut boundaries fail this event-only sensitivity.

interpretation: Descriptive boundary-complete sensitivity, not a new clinical primary endpoint or causal effect
